verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party export feature for bulk data export in open formats. The related evidence does not count toward this story: the Admin API ('anything you can do in the dashboard') is a developer building block from which an export could be built. Self-hosting control, OpenFeature SDK portability, and audit-log webhooks are adjacent features rather than a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
